decisions.reason: The footer-code correction is already fully represented by the candidate's message-59 INTRODUCE event with the exact DX18, DX19, and DX20 codes.
The page-one report-detail corrections for DX19 and DX20 are already fully represented by the candidate's message-59 INTRODUCE event.
The distinct risk-band titles stated in message 59 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE event.
Message 59 corrects content within the existing DX17–DX20 variants but does not change the variant set, editability, or selection basis.
The general internal-header presentation and required-information rules remain unchanged; exact per-variant header codes are owned by the source Requirement.
Correcting report titles and identifiers does not change the approved visual theme, reference design, or cross-variant styling.
The corrections do not change which result fields appear, their prominence, the score heading, or the front-page summary layout.
Correcting displayed report identifiers does not alter which customer fields must be editable or their editability standard.
Message 59 does not change the content, format, or detail level of the front-page result drivers.
The requirement for a consistent footer and its generic content remains unchanged; exact per-variant footer codes are already represented by the dedicated footer-identifier Requirement.
The identifier corrections do not alter the distribution warning's purpose, retention, or visual treatment.
Report-code corrections do not change the vehicle identifier displayed or its clean, non-checkbox presentation format.
